description: This dataset contains observations of the Mexican hoverfly species *Asemosyrphus mexicanus*, collected from various locations in Mexico, Colombia, Guatemala, and Ecuador. The records include taxonomic classifications, geographic coordinates, observation dates, and metadata such as identifiers, licenses, and contributors. The semantic profile highlights biodiversity-focused attributes, including taxonomic ranks, spatial filters (e.g., country, coordinates), temporal filters (e.g., event dates), and attribution details (e.g., recorded by, identified by). This dataset is useful for studying the distribution, habitat preferences, and temporal patterns of *Asemosyrphus mexicanus*, as well as for biodiversity research, conservation efforts, and ecological studies in the regions where these observations were made.
